titulo: 60-second script with the source on screen
hero_alt: Vertical phone showing a big animated number with the source line below it.
lead: With the base ready, the agent writes the script, and only from what is in the base. The radar opens with the date and the strongest number, covers each topic with the profile card of who said it, and ends with a question and the invitation. Before it becomes a video, the script goes through the check: if a number isn't in the base, the script goes back.
objetivo: ask the agent for a 60-second script from the base.md and send it back whenever a number isn't in the base.

aprende.t: The structure of the short: frame 0, summary, topics, question, CTA
The rules for the spoken lines, in the tone of a presenter
The request to the agent, ready to copy
The list of what fails a script

secoes.titulo: The structure of a radar short
secoes.sub: Tap each block. This is the format that finviral, saudeviral, and advviral follow.

nos.detalhe: The first frame is already full: the date dd/mm/yyyy and the strongest number (or fact). The first spoken line is the punchline of that number, and it never starts with "In this video," "Imagine," or "Hello."
Right after, a box with the topics coming up, one short item per topic. In the radar shorts there are at least five topics, from different influencers whenever possible, the strongest first.

itens.t: Profile card of who said it

nos.detalhe: Each topic is told in full: context, what the person said, what changes for the viewer. Each person cited gets the profile card (name, channel, date, views) and the source line: channel, YouTube, date, short title.
The second-to-last line asks where the person is watching from and what the situation is like in their city. The source for that scene carries the niche disclaimer, like "Not investment advice."
A short bridge from the topic to AI, and the invitation to learn at inema.club, with free courses. One destination only: no YouTube channel, no "subscribe," no "long video."

secoes.legenda: Example from the finviral repository. On your channel, swap the CTA for your own destination, but keep it to one destination.

secoes.sub: Each one came from a rejected video. The checar.py checks several of them on its own.

texto: All numbers and years are spelled out in the speech. The check rejects digits in the speech.

exemplo.texto: sete vírgula sete por cento · dois mil e vinte e oito

texto: Acronyms are read the way they are spoken. A government address has no "ponto": "consumidor gov bê érre". On screen it stays consumidor.gov.br.
Address the viewer as "você" (you), with short sentences. The check rejects "tu," "teu" and "tua."

exemplo.texto: This changes what you pay at the end of the month.

texto: Each visual comes in on an ordinary word of the speech (the anchor), never on a number: the avatar's transcript writes numbers as digits, so the anchor would not match.

secoes.titulo: The script request and the gate checklist
secoes.sub: Paste your base.md and your rules into the request. Then check it against the list.

blocos.conteudo:
Write the script for a 60-second vertical video using ONLY the
numbers and facts from the base.md below. Do not use the internet or any other source.

Structure:
1. Opening: the shock line with the strongest number (never "Imagine,"
   "Hello" or "In this video").
2. Three facts, each with who said it, the video and the date on screen.
3. The mandatory niche notice (it is in regras.md).
4. A question that invites comments.
5. The closing invitation, to one destination only.

Rules: address the viewer as "você"; numbers and years spelled out in the speech; every
number shown must be in the base.md. If the base does not have enough
material, answer only SEM PAUTA and the reason.

<paste the base.md>
<paste the regras.md>

- [ ] Every number on screen is in the base.md (with a literal excerpt)
- [ ] No number written as digits in the speech
- [ ] Opening with the strongest number, without "Imagine/Hello/In this video"
- [ ] Source (channel, date, title) in every scene with a fact
- [ ] Mandatory niche notice present
- [ ] Addresses the viewer as "você"
- [ ] Second-to-last line: comment question
- [ ] One destination only in the closing invitation

Failed: the script goes back once. Failed again: no video today.

abas.html:
• each excerpt from the base is in the transcript of the cited video;
  • numbers written as digits in the speech;
  • images exist;
  • CTA to inema.club in the last line;
  • the niche notice sentence;
  • "tu/teu/tua" in the speech and "gov" with "ponto".
The radars' prompt says to write all the files or only SEM_PAUTA.txt. When there is no material, the bot receives "sem pauta" and the reason. That is better than forcing a weak video.

exercicios.titulo: E4 · 60 s script with the source on screen
exercicios.texto: Ask the agent for the script using the request above: strongest number in the opening, three facts with who said them, the niche notice and the invitation. Check it against the gate checklist and send back whatever fails.
exercicios.pronto: every number in the script is in the base.md and the gate checklist is fully checked. If any number is not there, the script goes back.

secoes.fonte: The exercise asks for three facts to start with; the radars' short today requires at least five topics. Full exercise: jornada-agentes/exercicios/04-redes.md.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: The script has a number that is not in the base.md. What should you do?
opcoes: Send the script back: every number must be in the base, with a literal excerpt.
Remove the source from the screen.
Swap it for a rounded number.
Publish it if the number looks right.
perguntas.explica: The E4 rule: every number in the script is in the base.md. If it isn't, the script goes back.

perguntas.p: What is the best first line for a radar?
opcoes: "Hi, everyone, in this video we're going to look at the news."
The shock line with the strongest number of the day.
"Imagine if your rent went up tomorrow."
perguntas.explica: Frame 0 already shows the date and the number; the first line spoken is its shock line. "Hello," "Imagine" and "In this video" are banned in the opening.

perguntas.p: Why is the anchor of a visual never a number?
opcoes: Because the anchor has to be the person's name.
Because numbers don't show up on screen.
Because the avatar's transcript writes numbers as digits, and an anchor spelled out in words wouldn't match.
perguntas.explica: The speech says "twelve," the transcript writes "12." A common word, like "rent," always matches.

perguntas.p: The end of the script invites people to inema.club, to the YouTube channel, and to a long video. Is that right?
opcoes: Yes: the more destinations, the better.
Only if the video runs longer than 60 s.
Yes, as long as it's quick.
No: the closing invitation has only one destination.
perguntas.explica: On the radars, the CTA is always just inema.club. Three destinations split attention, and none gets followed.
